changelog:
**Summary: Major refocus and streamlining for marketing image creation and AI generation.**

- Rewritten to target creation, editing, and optimization of images specifically for marketing (blog heroes, social graphics, product mockups, banners, etc.).
- Strong new emphasis on AI image generation models (e.g., Gemini Image, Flux, Ideogram), design tools (Canva, Figma), and workflow choices.
- Outdated platform-specific and technical delivery files removed; replaced with concise, clear guidance on tool selection and workflow.
- Added reference to modern prompt design for AI image models and a new quickstart AI image prompting guide.
- Updated all tool and model recommendations for 2024 (e.g., DALL-E deprecated, new model/version names).
- Simplified instructions and user flow for general marketing image needs; platform-specific ad creative and video now delegated to other skills.
